pages.text: Smithing: star upgrade template (left), lesser armor (middle), star singularity (right). Each upgrade consumes one of each, preserving enchantments, custom name and damage. No cheap template duplication. A full set costs 4 nether stars, 24 netherite ingots, 24 diamond blocks, 16 star ingot blocks and 4 vanilla netherite upgrade templates. Nine star ingots compress into a reversible block.
